name: SRT → Multi RTMP
summary: Take one SRT input and broadcast it to multiple RTMP destinations in parallel — YouTube + Twitch + Facebook + your own server, all at once.
description: A multistreaming hub. Your OBS / FFmpeg / encoder sends one SRT stream to this pipeline; the pipeline fans it out to as many RTMP destinations as you list in a configuration table. Each row in the table picks one streaming service (from a built-in preset library of endpoints) plus your stream key for that service — the full RTMP URL is assembled automatically. Add a row to add a destination, remove a row to drop one; no rewiring required.

elements.name: srtsrc
elements.rationale: SRT MPEG-TS input. May need gst-plugins-bad on some distros.

elements.name: rtmp2sink
elements.rationale: Modern RTMP sink. Pre-1.18 builds may only ship rtmpsink.

variables.label: SRT Port
variables.description: TCP port the SRT listener binds on (0.0.0.0). The pipeline includes a Concat transform that assembles the full srt:// URI from this port.
